name: Mitsubishi Kasei 15 (火星一五型)

sources.navy-manual-1941: 海軍航空本部『火星発動機一〇型取扱説明書（火星11～15型）』, Jan 1941, as tabulated by JA Wikipedia 火星 (エンジン) with 坂上茂樹 2021 pp.459-460 and 旧『世界の傑作機』No.60 p.42; and by WarbirdPerformanceBlog (warbirdperformance.livedoor.blog/archives/6848816.html)
sources.taic-1: TAIC Manual No. 1, Japanese Aircraft Performance and Characteristics, Dec 1944, engine sheets pp.861-862 (ratings without an asterisk are from captured documents; p.850)

installed_in: G4M1 from about airframe No. 406 (Aug 1942; JA Wikipedia 一式陸上攻撃機 citing JACAR C12070526100), still called Model 11 until the Model 13 designation

gear_ratios.note: Not found; the JSBSim model derives each speed's pressure ratio from the rated boost and altitude, so the gear ratios are not needed.

change_altitude.note: Not in the sources. The JSBSim model changes speed at the first-speed rated altitude + 1,000 ft (jsbsim-rs set_switch).

carburettor.note: Mixture control not described; the model holds an auto-rich mixture.

conflicts: None found between the Navy manual (PS, m) and TAIC (hp, ft). TAIC gives no sea-level military rating for the Kasei 15.

jsbsim_model.note: Values the JSBSim piston model needs that no source gives. 'fitted' values are fitted to the ratings above by vehicles/tools/part_jsbsim.py's engine probe (crates/sim-pack tests), never to aircraft performance.

bsfc_indicated.note: overall power scale, fitted to the rated first-speed power

boost_loss_factor.note: kept at the Kasei 11's value; the compressor efficiency carries the fit

compressor_efficiency.note: charge heating T_amb*(1+(PR^0.2857-1)/eta), no intercooler; fitted to the fall from 1,400 to 1,280 hp between speeds. Higher than the Kasei 11's 0.56 because the same fall spans a larger second-speed pressure ratio.

ram_air_factor.note: the G4M1 No. 1 speed peaks sit only ~200 m above the static rated altitudes

mixture_phi_run.note: auto-rich equivalence ratio, as the P-38G model

feedforward_hp_per_inhg.note: rated first-speed power over (37.0 - 12) inHg of charge-corrected boost

bsfc_brake_rated.note: fuel flow over brake power of the JSBSim model at the rated first-speed point, for the ace-rs catalog entry; not sourced

fit_residuals.note: model power at each rating point against the rating
